cumleler: Can hearing loss appear after a baby passes newborn screening?
Congenital CMV is the top nongenetic cause of congenital sensorineural loss.
Most infected babies have no symptoms at birth and may pass screening.
The loss can begin after birth, fluctuate, and progress over time.
So even a baby who passed screening can develop loss later.
Audiologic follow-up at least yearly is recommended until age three.
